From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Day-of coordination: Serving at Scale — customer spotlight (runbook + liaison roles)

Team & Acme —

Thanks again for confirming the customer spotlight on Sept 9. I wanted to lock down day-of roles and share the first-pass runbook. High-level asks:

- Van: you are the SME greeter (5:45 PDT check-in, stage handover) and will introduce the Acme demo.
- Karthik: tech liaison / capture engineer (5:15 check, manage demo VM + fallback recording).
- Jordan / Sara: please confirm which demo flow (A or B) you want to show and whether we should pre-load any datasets.

I've attached the runbook (webinar_runbook_v1.docx) and a short slide deck draft. Please respond with any changes by EOD so I can publish final runbook to the event folder.

Day-of timings (draft):
- 15:45 PDT: AV tech check (internal only)
- 16:00 PDT: Speaker check-in + slide handoff
- 16:15 PDT: Attendee gates open
- 16:30 PDT: Live start — 35m panel + 10m demo + 15m Q&A

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: webinar_runbook_v1.docx, intro_slide_deck.pdf

Thanks Marcus — good outline. Couple of notes: 

- Confirming my check-in at 5:45 PDT; I’ll be on camera-ready 5:55.
- For the intro I’ll use the 1-slide Acme callout you included; please add the customer logo to slide 2 (I don’t have the final).
- I’ll need the exact Zoom co-host rights before 5:30 so I can mute/unmute panelists and spotlight Jordan.

I attached a refined slide (intro_slide_deck.pdf) with logo placeholder and a 30s talking script for the greeter. Also attaching a small pre-demo checklist I’ll run with Karthik.

On the fallback: if the live demo hits network issues we pivot to a recorded walkthrough at 16:45 — Karthik, can you confirm you have that recording staged?

—Vanessa

Thanks all — we want to run Demo Flow B (multi-tenant inference + KV cache example). Two quick asks: 
1) We need a 2-minute window before our demo to adjust the dataset (preload small user history). I’ll send the CSV by EOD today.
2) Can we confirm whether the audience Q&A will be moderated or open? If moderated, where should questions be routed?

Also, please send any required NDAs for the demo sample data (we can provide synthetic data if needed).

Jordan Hayes
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Systems

Answers: 
- Q&A will be moderated. All live questions go to the Zoom Q&A module; Vanessa will triage and pass 3 live questions at ~16:55 to the panel. We’ll leave open the chat for attendee comments.
- NDAs: not required for the dataset itself if it’s anonymized. If Acme prefers, we can sign a short data handling addendum — I’ll loop Legal if you ask for it.

I’m uploading the runbook to the shared Drive folder now (link below) and attaching a small pre-demo data spec (pre-demo-data-specs.csv) that lists the fields we need. Karthik — can you confirm you have a staged VM + fallback recording?

Marcus
